headline: The Quiet City
standfirst: A street designed for walking speed changes what people do on it. Notes on narrowing, shading and slowing the everyday street.
caption_plan: Fig. 1 — A residential grid re-planned around a shaded spine. Through-traffic is moved to the perimeter; the interior becomes a sequence of slow streets and small squares.
caption_section: Fig. 2 — Street section, before and after. Carriageway narrowed to one lane; trees and seating take the reclaimed width.
pullquote: Speed is a design decision. Every metre of asphalt is an invitation to drive faster.
